description: Change fields of the saved profile without re-uploading the CV. Send only the fields to change (full_name, contact_email, phone, location, city, address, postcode, professional_summary, skills, pinned_skills, languages, experience, education, projects, certifications, links, …); everything else is untouched. The feed is re-ranked against the new CV.
